description: Returns the signed-in account's audio generations, newest first, one page at a time (pass `cursor` from the previous `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true). WHEN: the user asks what they have made, or you need a voice-over, track or sound effect from an earlier session. It is the account's top-level audio, including audio made in the web app; it excludes the clips other products generate INSIDE a job (the per-line voice-overs behind a story or fake-text video).

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: list_audio
title: List the account's AI audio
